{"path":"todo_zai-glm-5.3-flash_01.html","edit_description":"Create a brand-new, fully self-contained single-file Todo web app in English. No external dependencies, no CDNs, no frameworks — all CSS in a <style> tag and all JS in a <script> tag at the end of <body>.

Required features (all must work):
1. Add new todos: a text input + "Add" button; adding works on button click AND on Enter key. Empty/whitespace-only input must be ignored (do not add empty todos). Trim the text. After adding, clear the input and refocus it.
2. Mark todos as complete: clicking a checkbox next to a todo toggles its done state; completed todos show line-through strikethrough text plus a muted/greyed style.
3. Delete todos: each todo row has a Delete (×) button that removes that todo.
4. Filters: three filter buttons "All", "Active", "Completed". The currently active filter is visually highlighted. Filtering hides non-matching todos (use a data-driven re-render). Also show a counter of remaining (active) items, e.g. "3 items left" (handle singular "1 item left").
5. Persistence: save todos (array of {id, text, done}) AND the selected filter to localStorage (key e.g. "todos_v1" and "todos_filter_v1"). Load and restore them on page load, wrapped in try/catch so corrupt JSON doesn't break the app (fall back to empty array / "all" filter). Save after every mutation (add, toggle, delete, filter change).

Implementation quality requirements:
- IDs: generate unique ids via Date.now() + random or a counter.
- XSS-safe rendering: insert todo text via document.createElement / textContent (NOT innerHTML with user text).
- Use an array `todos` as the single source of truth; one render() function re-renders the list from state; small handler functions addTo do, toggleTodo(id), deleteTodo(id), setFilter(name).
- Also add a "Clear completed" button that removes all done todos (nice-to-have, small).
- Double-click on todo text to edit it inline is NOT required — skip it, keep it simple.
- Sensible UX polish: checkboxes are real <input type="checkbox"> bound to done state; todo row has hover style; delete button styled subtly (red on hover).
- Clean modern styling: centered card layout (max-width ~520px), system font stack, soft shadow, rounded corners, light background (e.g. #f4f4f5 page, white card), accent color for buttons/active filter (e.g. #4f46e5 indigo).
- Accessibility basics: <label> for the new-todo input (visually hidden label is fine), buttons with clear text or aria-labels, filter buttons use aria-pressed.
- The page must work by just opening the file in a browser (file:// protocol) — no server needed. Language of UI text: English. Title: "Todo App".

Structure: <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, meta charset + viewport, <title>, <style>, semantic HTML (main container, header h1, form for adding, ul#todo-list for items, div for filters and footer counter), <script> with 'use strict'."}
